_meta.scenario: Driver became unavailable after being assigned — e.g., vehicle breakdown, medical emergency. Admin re-assigns or cancels the trip. Full refund triggered as Cabbo is responsible.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = true → full refund triggered. Use this over 'driver_cancelled' when the driver had a genuine operational issue.

reason: Assigned driver became unavailable due to vehicle issue. Trip cancelled.

cancelation_detail.reason: Driver reported vehicle breakdown on the way to pickup location. Customer notified and refund initiated.
